title: The Clovehitch Killer
description: After Tyler finds a cache of disturbing images in his father's possession, he begins to suspect that the man he trusts most in the world may be responsible for a series of unsolved murders.

title: ATM
description: A murderous assailant traps three people (Alice Eve, Josh Peck, Brian Geraghty) in a small kiosk containing an automatic teller machine.

title: Nobody Gets Out Alive
description: Hunter's (Brian Gallagher) life turns upside down after his daughter is killed by a drunken driver. He disappears into the woods, and no one sees him for years -- until several partying teenagers are brutally killed one by one.

title: Way of the Wicked
description: When a town is swept by a series of gruesome killings, a mysterious priest (Christian Slater) seems to be the only one who can help protect them from a truth more evil than any of them could have imagined.

title: The Hallow
description: A family is forced to fight demonic creatures for survival after they move into a remote mill house in Ireland.

title: Would You Rather
description: Iris (Brittany Snow) and seven other desperate people become trapped in Shepard's (Jeffrey Combs) mansion. Shepard forces them to play a sadistic game for a large sum of money -- but the dilemmas become increasingly deadly.

title: Caveat
description: A desperate drifter suffering from partial memory loss agrees to look after his landlord's psychologically troubled niece in an isolated island mansion.

title: Phobia
description: Jonathan suffers from agoraphobia after his wife dies in a car accident. As his self-loathing escalates, he is haunted by twisted visions that tear away his sanity.

title: #Horror
description: Preteen girls face a night of terror when their obsession with a disturbing online game goes too far.

title: Haunter
description: The ghost of a teenager (Abigail Breslin) tries to protect a young girl (Eleanor Zichy) and her family from a dead serial killer (Stephen McHattie) who can possess the living.

title: The Bunker Game
description: After several mysterious accidents, a live-action role playing game is interrupted and the players leave the bunker while the staff remains behind to investigate the disappearance of the game's mastermind, Greg.

title: Knives and Skin
description: In the wake of a high school student's mysterious disappearance, a collective awakening seems to overcome the town's teenage girls -- gathering in force until it can no longer be contained.

title: Entrance
description: Things lurking on the periphery of people's lives lead to horrific conclusions.

title: The Pact
description: Disturbing visions and her sister's disappearance lead a woman (Caity Lotz) to call a cop (Casper Van Dien) and a psychic to her childhood home.

title: The Twin
description: What begins as a time of healing in the quiet Scandinavian countryside soon takes an ominous turn when a woman begins to unravel the torturous truth about her son and confronts the malicious forces that are trying to take hold of him.

title: Relic
description: A woman links her mother's increasingly volatile behavior to an evil presence at their family's decaying country home.

title: They Live in the Grey
description: While investigating a child abuse case, a young social worker discovers that the family is being tormented by a supernatural entity. In order to save the parents from losing custody of their child, she must stop the malevolent force.
